headline: 5Paisa Capital Limited: Preferential issue
sum: Preferential issue — 5paisa Capital Limited has informed the Exchange about Revision in the Disclosure regarding Acquisition of Giskard Datatech Private Limited approved at the Board Meeting held on July 28, 2026.
